items.title: Palantir Shares Jump on ‘Otherworldly’ Sales, Improved Forecast
items.summary: Palantir  shares rose as much as 13% in after-market trading after the company lifted its full-year outlook  and reported accelerating growth in its U.S. commercial sales.  Revenue nearly doubled in the second quarter, the technology company told investors Monday.  Palantir previously forecast full-year revenue to come in under $7.7 billion.
